ENQUIRY CENTRE

Quick answers before you contact DOTLEGACY.

How do I place an order?

Choose a product, review its details and contact customer service for the next step.

Can I ask about a package?

Yes. Use the Investment Enquiry or contact customer service for package information.

Can I enquire about property?

Yes. Select Property Projects and contact customer service for available information.

Can I enquire about machinery?

Yes. Use the Transport & Machinery enquiry option.

How do I get support?

Call or message customer service on 09169100193.

Want a custom enquiry?

Contact DOTLEGACY and state the product, package or opportunity you want to know about.
